entities.summary: The Berlinka ('Berliner'), also depozyt berliński and skarb pruski, is the Polish name for a collection of German original manuscripts originally kept at the Prussian State Library in Berlin, which have been held by the Jagiellonian Library in Kraków since the end of World War II. The legal status of the documents is subject to ongoing debate.
